What the Claude Code setup page says about coverage

Claude Code's built-in tools don't all route through MCP. KYA gates the MCP path completely; what the host executes natively never reaches evaluate. For shell-level coverage of any command, use the wrap fallback below.

Source: the Claude Code recipe.

Install

The plugin for Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
